title: Reading for Intent
description: Reconstruct what a piece of code is trying to do before judging whether it does it — starting from the signature and the return, not the top of the file.

title: Control Flow and State
description: Trace every path through a piece of code, including the ones nobody thought about — the branches that never fire, the state that outlives the function that touched it, and the loops that only usually stop.

title: Data Shapes and Boundaries
description: Find the places where the shape of data crossing a boundary is assumed rather than checked — what a function believes about its input, where that belief was supposed to be verified, and where it wasn't.

title: Dependencies and What They Cost
description: Judge whether a dependency an AI tool reached for should be in your project at all — what it's actually buying you, what it costs in licensing and maintenance, and whether it's even a real package.

title: Tests as a Reading Tool
description: Use a test suite to learn what code is supposed to do — and notice when the suite is lying, passing not because the code is right but because nothing in it was actually checked.
